values.note: Deluxe and basic sites $40 a day ($240 a week, $840 a month); premium waterfront sites $48 ($288 a week), the only sites stated to take rigs to 40 ft. Electric tent sites $30, rustic $25. Rates are undated on a page published with the 2026 season; 'all rates are subject to change'. Boat docking $15 a day.

values.note: Laid out decades ago for pop-ups and compact 20-foot trailers, the sites are snug and narrow; 'a few larger spots' (the premium sites) take rigs up to 40 ft.

sites.source: https://www.loonspointcampground.com/about ('Book the Premium Sites: We've created a few larger spots that can accommodate rigs up to 40 feet'; 'families rolled in with pop-ups, teardrops, or compact 20-foot trailers ... The layout of our campground was designed for that era'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.loonspointcampground.com/ ('2026 Park Season: May 15 - October 1'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Call (906) 484-2881 to reserve. Deposit fully refunded through May 1, 50% from then until 30 days out, nothing after; a no-show is charged in full. Check-in 1 pm to sunset, check-out 11 am. One camping unit and one car, at most four adults, per site.

booking.source: https://www.loonspointcampground.com/ ('Call and reserve a spot here!', '(906) 484-2881') + https://www.loonspointcampground.com/park-rates (cancellation and no-show policy, 'Things to Note'), read 2026-10-22

note: Private campground on the Les Cheneaux channel of Lake Huron, 1.5 mi E of Cedarville, family-owned for 40+ years: about 54 RV sites set unusually close to the water's edge on the original narrow layout, plus tent sites, a cabin and a guest house. Small swim beach, boat docking, kayak rentals. --Claude
summary: Operator site read (phone 906-484-2881 matches). Confirmed $40 deluxe/basic - $48 premium waterfront (undated rates on the 2026-season site), full hookups, phone reservations; added 2026 season May 15 - Oct 1, dump station, laundry, max 40 ft (premium sites only), booking terms. Electric 50 (derived) left: the site states no amperage. Note cleaned of hookup, season and booking text. Not seasonal in character (daily/weekly/monthly only, no seasonal rate).
flags: Site size: the operator says the layout 'was designed for' pop-ups and 'compact 20-foot trailers' and the sites are 'snug'; only 'a few' premium sites ($48) are stated to take rigs to 40 ft. A 23-ft Class C may need a premium site, in which case the base is $48, still under US$50.
